headline: Liam Scales scores header as Celtic beat St Mirren 2-1
standfirst: Celtic turned a 1-0 deficit around after Scales' early second‑half goal.
body:
![](img/articles/liam-scales-scores-header-as-celtic-beat-st-mirren-2-1/lead.jpg)

Celtic secured a 2-1 away victory over St Mirren, overturning a 1-0 deficit thanks to a second‑half header from Liam Scales that levelled the score early in the period. The win came after the match, which was played the previous day, saw Celtic rally to claim all three points.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Celtic won 2-1 away at St Mirren.
Liam Scales headed the equaliser early in the second half after Celtic fell behind 1-0.
The match took place the day before the post was made.

headline: Aaron Drinan nets hat‑trick for Swell Town against Colchester
standfirst: He has scored five goals in his first five games this season.
body:
![](img/articles/aaron-drinan-nets-hat-trick-for-swell-town-against-colchester/lead.jpg)

Aaron Drinan produced a hat‑trick for Swell Town in today's match versus Colchester United, taking his season tally to five goals from five games. The striker, who claimed the League Two Player of the Year award after scoring 22 goals last season, kept his scoring run alive. This five‑match goal streak underscores a strong opening to the campaign.
author: Jack Deane
_facts: Aaron Drinan scored a hat‑trick for Swell Town against Colchester United today.
The hat‑trick brought his tally to five goals in his first five games of the season.
He scored 22 goals last season.
He won the League Two Player of the Year award last season.
